chunks: When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh: 'Is there a reward for us if we are victorious?'
ai.seo_question: What did the magicians ask Pharaoh regarding their reward?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, the Egyptian magicians approach Pharaoh to negotiate their compensation, explicitly conditioning their reward on their victory over Moses (AS). This highlights the transactional nature of their faith and their reliance on worldly recognition rather than divine truth, a theme often explored in Shia exegesis as a contrast to the sincere belief of the common people who later followed Moses.
